candidates.description: Different premises for today's series. Each one complete.

ranking.description: Candidate indexes, funniest and most send-to-your-family first. Be honest: rank by how hard a real Indian daughter would laugh and send it to her mum or sister.

title.description: Short internal name, e.g. 'The Amazon parcel'

premise.description: One sentence: the situation and the punchline, used to avoid repeats

clock.description: Phone clock, 24h, fitting the story (03:40 for a late-night one)

who.description: them = Mummy, me = the daughter, react = an emoji reaction on Mummy's last message, time = the clock jumps to text (HH:MM) for what follows, e.g. she replies hours later

kind.description: Default text. voice = a voice note, text is its length like '0:14' (Mummy's are long). missed-call = Mummy's missed voice call (text ''). deleted = Mummy's arrives as 'This message was deleted'; the daughter's is sent, then deleted a second later, so the viewer still reads it

forwarded.description: Shows WhatsApp's 'Forwarded' label: Mummy's good-morning wisdom, health tips, news

text.description: The message exactly as typed. For react: one emoji. For time: HH:MM. For voice: the length, e.g. '0:47'. For missed-call: ''

pause.description: Optional extra seconds before this item, for comic timing

cover.description: The reel's cover (shown on the profile grid and as the end card). It sells the situation, never the punchline.

headline.description: 3-7 words, first person or about Mummy, with exactly one *word (the key noun) that gets a green marker. E.g. 'Mummy found my *Swiggy order', 'I lied about *dinner', 'Mummy washed my *hoodie'.

emoji.description: One emoji that shows the feeling (😭 😳 💀 🫠), or a thing in the story (📦 📍 🧥)

caption.description: Optional end-card text, lowercase, 2-6 words. Usually not shown.
Instagram caption: one short reaction line, then a line that makes people send it to their mum, sister or best friend ('send this to your mumma'). No hashtags.

youtubeTitle.description: Plain, curious title for YouTube Shorts

idea.description: If this chat is built on one of today's real ideas, its number; leave it out otherwise
